issues.reason: The Existential section states that a definite description picking out a specific thing is a typed individual sk_<class>_<n> plus its Member atom and reserves the bare class symbol for non-specific/generic fillers "never for a specific definite individual", so (Agent sk_attract_1 mist_light) for the definite subject "The mist-light" violates a stated rule; the reviewer's secondary class-vs-individual-position framing is weaker, since bare kind role fillers carrying Inheritance genus atoms are licensed for genuinely non-specific objects.

Once the postural state is reified (licensed here by the "that night" time modifier), Where a THING is prescribes "Experiencer subject + Location oblique", and the thematic-roles list assigns Location to where-PPs headed by "in/at/on", so the event-attached (On (sk_stay $x) sk_cliff_spires_1) is a mis-slotted head that no "where" PP on an eventuality may take.

gaps_confirmed: Seasons have no calendar Time term — they appear only as deictic constants (last_spring / next_summer) — so a year-anchored season ("the late summer of Year 1") must be improvised as a bare symbol composed with (Year 1).

An ordinally-indexed named sub-day period ("the third watch") has no structured Time term: only a flat bare constant on the first_quarter precedent is licensed, which loses the ordinal index, and Ordinal's scale slot is defined for an associated event or an explicit -est dimension, not a period's own class word.
new_gaps: "stay / remain + locative PP" has no carrier for the continuation the verb asserts (the instruction set itself says to record the gap), so "All the sky-cats stayed on the cliff-spires" loses the already-there-and-remained component entirely.
defect_summary: For the definite "The mist-light" the compliant form is a typed individual — (Member sk_mist_light_1 mist_light) with (Agent sk_attract_1 sk_mist_light_1), the same witness carried over from the produce clause; for the reified stay state the compliant oblique is the event-side (Location (sk_stay $x) sk_cliff_spires_1).
notes: The reviewer's "third watch" gap is overstated — a flat bare constant third_watch is licensed by the first_quarter precedent — but the parse's (Time sk_count_1 sk_watch_1) instead puts a minted entity witness in a Time slot the instruction set fills only with structured terms or bare constants, which the review did not raise as an issue. Everything else (names, compound genera, the BeforeBy gap to the equinox anchor, the handful CardinalityPhrase, the collective gather with no per-member rule, and the universal rule plus QuantifierPhrase) is per doctrine.
